commands.summary: Plan and execute the create conversation reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tavus create conversation apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: starts a real-time video conversation, which begins consuming conversational-minutes billing immediately and (unless test_mode) places a live call
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create document reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tavus create document apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: uploads a document to the knowledge base; processing is asynchronous and the document becomes available to PALs only once status reaches ready
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create guardrail reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tavus create guardrail apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new behavioral guardrail; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create objective reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tavus create objective apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates one or more new PAL objectives; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
commands.notes: named_dependency=engine.reverse_etl_scalar_flag_contract: the reverse-ETL command surface cannot faithfully expose this action's required object or array record fields as scalar flags

examples: pm tavus create pal apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new PAL persona; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create pronunciation dictionary reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tavus create pronunciation dictionary apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new pronunciation dictionary; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create video reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tavus create video apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: generates a new async video render from a face and script/audio; consumes video-generation minutes on the account
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete conversation reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tavus delete conversation apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently deletes a conversation and its recorded history; use end_conversation instead for routine call cleanup
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete document reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tavus delete document apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently deletes a knowledge-base document and its processed data; any PAL referencing it via document_ids loses that knowledge source immediately
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete guardrail reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tavus delete guardrail apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently deletes a guardrail; any PAL referencing it via guardrail_ids loses that behavioral boundary immediately
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete objective reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tavus delete objective apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently deletes an objective; any PAL referencing it via objectives_id loses that goal-oriented instruction immediately
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete pal reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tavus delete pal apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently deletes a PAL; any conversation still referencing its pal_id will fail to start
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete pronunciation dictionary reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tavus delete pronunciation dictionary apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently deletes a pronunciation dictionary and removes it from every linked PAL
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete video reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tavus delete video apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently deletes a generated video and its hosted/download URLs
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

examples: pm tavus documents list --json

commands.summary: Plan and execute the end conversation reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tavus end conversation apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: ends an active conversation for every participant; routine call cleanup, not destructive to conversation history (compare delete_conversation)
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
